name: Shamrock Plastics Inc.
old_description: Shamrock Plastics is a custom plastic fabrication company you want to do business with. We’re family-owned – and we treat all of our clients like family. Since 1989, we’ve been building plastic products of all shapes and sizes and relationships that last a lifetime. Based in both Ohio and South Carolina, there isn’t a product we haven’t laid our eyes on – or are hands – in the nearly 30 years we’ve been in business. You can trust us to get the job done right. Why? Because here are some things we’ve believed in since day one:
about:
Shamrock Plastics was founded in 1989 by Tom Ruffner in Mount Vernon, Ohio. The family-owned business began in a modest 10-by-20-foot storage space, with Ruffner drumming up work by going door to door after learning the trade out of high school and attending ITT Technical College. In 2012, Ruffner and his wife Deb relocated to Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, leaving the Ohio operation in the hands of their son Jay.

The company specializes in custom plastic fabrication, offering services from design and cutting through production and distribution. With facilities in both Mount Vernon and Myrtle Beach, the team draws on more than 100 years of combined experience in plastic fabrication. Shamrock handles domestic and international shipping for finished parts, managing the entire process from initial concept to delivery.

Shamrock serves customers across a range of industries that require custom plastic components, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. The company emphasizes a client-focused approach, treating each project with the same care regardless of size or complexity.

The founders built the business on a philosophy of not cutting corners, promising consistent quality, on-time delivery, and on-budget performance. That family-oriented culture, combined with deep technical expertise, is presented as the core differentiator.
